items.summary: MISP's LinOTPAuth plugin, used for one-time-password authentication against a LinOTP server, did not enforce TLS server certificate verification when the LinOTPAuth.verifyssl configuration option was not explicitly set. In a default or minimally configured deployment, the authentication request to the LinOTP server was sent without peer or peer-name certificate validation, effectively allowing self-signed or spoofed certificates. An attacker with a network position between the MISP instance and the LinOTP server could perform a man-in-the-middle attack to intercept or tamper with the authentic…

items.title: CVE-2026-135240
items.summary: MISP contains an authorization bypass in its tag attachment functionality. The endpoints responsible for editing event tags, editing attribute tags, and adding tags to event reports accepted arbitrary tag IDs without verifying whether the authenticated user was permitted to attach the referenced tag. The events/addTag endpoint already resolved tag IDs through a restricted lookup that enforced per-user and per-organisation tag visibility rules. However, the three tag-editor endpoints (editEventTags, editAttributeTags, and eventReports/addTag) passed the supplied tag IDs directly to the attachme…

items.title: CVE-2026-135213
items.summary: Worklenz before 3.4.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in GET /api/v1/activity-logs/:id that allows authenticated users to read other teams' task activity logs because it lacks the verifyTaskAccess middleware. Attackers who know another team's task UUID can retrieve reporter and assignee names and avatars plus the full timeline of status, priority, label and estimation changes.

items.title: CVE-2026-135212
items.summary: AiSOC before 23.6.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the agents service that allows authenticated users to read other tenants' investigation runs by supplying their run_id. Attackers can query GET /api/v1/investigations/{run_id}, report variants, the WebSocket stream, or agent-runs routes to obtain audit logs, forensic output, and incident reports.

items.title: CVE-2026-135210
items.summary: Plane before 1.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in WorkspaceDraftIssueViewSet that allows authenticated workspace members to create drafts in unauthorized projects by supplying an arbitrary project_id. Attackers can convert drafts into work items in private or removed-from projects with chosen title, state, assignees, cycle_id and module_ids, triggering notifications and disclosing project membership.

items.title: CVE-2026-135207
items.summary: Healthchecks before 4.4 contains a verification bypass vulnerability that allows project users to mark arbitrary email addresses as verified because Channel.make_token() omits the email address. Attackers can verify an address they control, change the integration to a victim address, then reuse the original link to send unsolicited alert emails.

items.title: CVE-2026-135206
items.summary: ToDesktop Builder before 0.36.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the todesktop-fs custom protocol handler that allows attackers to escape the bundled files directory using ../ sequences. Attackers who can run script in an application's renderer can issue XMLHttpRequest calls with traversal paths to read arbitrary files accessible to the user.

items.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in the EasyVistas EV Reach Client Agent allows authenticated users with low privileges to execute arbitrary commands on a remote Windows endpoint with LocalSystem privileges. The affected agent service does not sufficiently enforce authorization restrictions for certain privileged remote management operations. Under specific conditions, the agent fails to apply the intended user impersonation mechanism and executes user-supplied commands within the security context of the agent service, which runs as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM. As a result, an authenticated att…

items.title: CVE-2026-135235
items.summary: MISP contains a stored cross-site script (XSS) vulnerability in the event review page used for merge, import, and enrichment workflows. Object references displayed on this page include the UUID, name, and meta-category of the referenced object. These values originate from imported data (another event, a module result, or an import file) and were rendered into the HTML output without any encoding or sanitization. An attacker who can supply or influence imported MISP-format data can embed arbitrary HTML or JavaScript in the referenced object's UUID, name, or meta-category fields. When a user vie…

items.title: CVE-2026-135233
items.summary: MISP's interactive CLI shell, when used to edit or disable a user account, did not update the user record's modification timestamp. The application's session validation mechanism relies on this timestamp to detect that a user's record has changed and to reload the user's state in all active sessions. As a result, a user who was disabled or had their role or permissions modified through the CLI would retain their existing authenticated session and continue to operate with their previous privileges until the session naturally expired. The administrative intent to revoke or reduce access was not…

items.title: CVE-2026-135091
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in humhub rest up to 0.12.6. This affects an unknown part of the file views/admin/bearer-auth.php of the component Bearer Token Administration Page. The manipulation results in cross site scripting. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 0.12.7 is able to mitigate this issue. The patch is identified as 4d6870ff20242db534d75a062bafa88e9c771019. You should upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-12429
items.summary: This issue was not considered a security vulnerability.

items.title: CVE-2026-116032
items.summary: Stack buffer overflow vulnerability in Apache Perl. This issue affects Apache Perl: from 1.99_01 through 2.0.13. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.14, which fixes the issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-135177
items.summary: LibRaw through 0.22.3 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in LibRaw::pentax_4shot_load_raw() that allows attackers to crash applications by scanning tiff_ifd[] beyond its 10 entries. Attackers can supply a crafted four-frame Pentax DNG with too few IFDs matching the raw dimensions to cause denial of service when LIBRAW_RAWOPTIONS_PENTAX_PS_ALLFRAMES is enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-135176
items.summary: LibRaw 0.22.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in LibRaw::xtrans_interpolate() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted X-Trans raw files. When wavelet denoising threshold or chromatic aberration correction is enabled, the destimage buffer is sized from halved iwidth/iheight but indexed at full width, causing writes of file-derived pixel values beyond the allocation and crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-135173
items.summary: PdfPig through 0.1.16 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying crafted PDF documents with self-referencing AcroForm /Kids or deeply nested marked content. Attackers can trigger an uncatchable StackOverflowException in AcroFormFactory.GetAcroField or Page.GetOptionalContentsRecursively, terminating any process reading form fields or optional content.

items.title: CVE-2026-135172
items.summary: Question2Answer through 1.8.8 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the qa-include/ajax/version.php admin version-check handler that allows authenticated administrators to make the server send arbitrary HTTP GET requests. Attackers can supply a loopback, private-network, or cloud metadata address in the uri POST parameter with isCore=true to read internal service responses returned in the Ajax output.

items.title: CVE-2026-135170
items.summary: Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a Lua code injection vulnerability that allows LDAP-authenticated users to inject Lua statements into session files via unescaped login names. Attackers can log in with a name containing a Lua long-string terminator followed by code, which executes on a later session request as the Wing FTP service account.

items.title: CVE-2026-135169
items.summary: msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3.0.0 through cpp-9.0.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the Boost.X3 parser in include/msgpack/v2/x3_parse.hpp when built with MSGPACK_USE_X3_PARSE in reference mode. Attackers can supply crafted msgpack input parsed over buffering iterators so decoded str, bin and ext objects hold dangling pointers, disclosing freed heap memory or crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-135167
items.summary: LibRaw 0.22.0 through 0.22.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in HuffTable::len() because parse_dht() stores Huffman DC symbols without validating them as difference categories. Attackers can supply a crafted TIFF/ARW file with oversized Huffman symbols in a Sony YCbCr lossless JPEG stream to crash applications decoding it, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-135166
items.summary: Umbraco CMS 17.4.0 before 17.8.2 and 18.0.0 before 18.3.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because MemberValueSetBuilder.GetValueSets writes sensitive member properties into the Examine members index. Backoffice users with Settings and Members access but outside the Sensitive data group can search the index via the Examine Management dashboard or Management API to read hidden sensitive member values.

items.title: CVE-2026-135164
items.summary: Formance Ledger 2.2.0-beta.3 before 2.4.18 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote API callers to execute SQL by supplying unvalidated account expand values. items.title: CVE-2026-134492
items.summary: In mcp-server-fetch from 2026.10.10 and before 2026.11.11, the check that blocks requests to non-public addresses treats IPv6 site-local addresses (fec0::/10) as public. A fetch to such an address passes the server-side request forgery guard. Practical impact is limited because many hosts have no route to this range.

items.title: CVE-2026-134465
items.summary: In mcp-server-git before 2026.10.28, the --repository restriction can be bypassed through a nested directory that contains a .git file with a gitdir pointer to a repository outside the allowed path. A caller who can invoke the server's tools, place such a file in the allowed tree, and knows the outside repository's path can read committed content from that repository and create branches in it.

items.title: CVE-2026-135258
items.summary: MISP contains multiple related authorization and input-validation flaws in its object editing and attachment handling workflows. - A user with permission to edit their own object could inject a foreign attribute identifier into the object revision form. The revision data, stored in the server-side session, was merged into the stored object before the save diff was computed. The save then wrote to the foreign attribute row by its identifier without verifying that the row belonged to the caller's event or organisation, allowing an attacker to overwrite or soft-delete an attribute in another orga…

items.title: CVE-2026-135253
items.summary: MISP's NIDS rule export functionality for Snort and Suricata formats does not properly escape user-controlled data before embedding it into generated rule text. Attribute values, tag names, and URL paths are inserted directly into rule options (msg, metadata, content matches) without neutralizing characters that are syntactically significant in the NIDS rule grammar, such as double quotes, semicolons, backslashes, commas, and control characters. An authenticated user with the ability to create or modify attributes in a MISP instance can craft attribute values or tag names containing these spec…

items.title: CVE-2026-135245
items.summary: MISP's LDAP authentication components (LdapAuth plugin and Apache LDAP authentication) unconditionally re-enabled user accounts that had been disabled by an administrator. During the user provisioning or update step of an LDAP login, the disabled flag was reset to enabled regardless of the account's current state. This allowed any user with valid LDAP credentials to bypass an administrative disable action simply by authenticating, effectively nullifying the ability to revoke access through account deactivation. - Affects the LdapAuth plugin and the ApacheSecureAuth component - The insecure beh…

items.title: CVE-2026-135242
items.summary: MISP contains an authorization flaw in the Sharing Group Blueprint execution path. When a blueprint is executed, it rewrites the organisation roster of the associated sharing group. The check verifying that the blueprint's owning organisation still holds the right to extend (modify) that group was performed only once, at the time the blueprint was created. It was not re-evaluated at execution time. As a result, an organisation that subsequently lost its extend permission or was entirely removed from the sharing group could still execute its existing blueprint and overwrite the group's organisa…

items.title: CVE-2026-135239
items.summary: MISP contains an authorization flaw in the data capture and import paths for events, galaxies, galaxy clusters, analyst data, and sightings. A user who is neither a sync user nor a site admin could create or import records attributed to an organisation other than their own, or cause the creation of a new organisation from a payload-supplied identifier. The root cause is an inconsistent authorization check: the code validated one representation of the creator organisation (for example a numeric ID or a UUID field) while storing a different representation taken directly from the user-supplied pa…

items.title: CVE-2026-107784
items.summary: On Windows, the tarfile "tar" and "data" extraction filters did not reject member names or link targets that have a drive but no root, such as "C:foo". When extracting to a relative destination, such a member was written to the current working directory of that drive instead of the destination, and a symbolic link with such a target pointed outside the destination. The filters now refuse these member names and link targets with AbsolutePathError and AbsoluteLinkError.

items.title: CVE-2026-135232
items.summary: MISP Collections retained a sharing group reference (sharing_group_id) even when the collection's distribution level was below 4 (i.e., not restricted to a sharing group). As a result, the sharing group name and UUID were displayed in the collection index and view endpoints to any user who could see the collection, regardless of whether that user was a member of the sharing group. Additionally, when collections were pushed to remote MISP servers, the sharing group data was included in the push payload even for collections not distributed to a sharing group, potentially leaking the group identi…

items.title: CVE-2026-135231
items.summary: MISP contains an authorization bypass in the galaxy cluster detachment functionality. Users holding the sync role permission were incorrectly exempted from the tagger and organisation ownership checks when detaching galaxy clusters from events or attributes. This allowed a sync user belonging to one organisation to remove galaxy cluster associations (threat intelligence tags) from events and attributes owned by a different organisation. The sync permission was intended for replication workflows, which never invoke the cluster detachment code path, but was erroneously used as a blanket authoriz…

items.title: CVE-2026-133632
items.summary: In astro-airflow-mcp 0.5.0 through 0.9.1, the af CLI and the MCP server send telemetry from a Python subprocess that can import modules from the current working directory. If a user runs an af command or an MCP tool call from inside a project that contains an attacker-supplied json.py, that file runs with the user's privileges. Users who only run the tool in projects they trust are not affected. Fixed in 0.9.2; in earlier versions, setting AF_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 prevents it.

items.title: CVE-2026-135168
items.summary: msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3.0.0 through cpp-9.0.0, when built with MSGPACK_USE_X3_PARSE, contains an out-of-bounds heap read in x3_parse.hpp due to assuming contiguous input. Attackers can supply msgpack str, bin or ext values unpacked from non-contiguous containers like std::deque, causing memcpy past storage blocks and disclosing adjacent heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-59442
items.summary: TypesenseFilterExpressionConverter does not correctly translate grouped (parenthesized) filter expressions into the Typesense filter syntax. As a result, the filter sent to Typesense can have a different meaning than the one the application defined, and some conditions may not be applied as intended. An application is affected if it uses the Typesense vector store with filter expressions that contain groups and relies on them to restrict results, for example to enforce tenant isolation or access control. In that case, a remote user may be able to retrieve documents they should not have access…

items.title: CVE-2026-59340
items.summary: PagePdfDocumentReader and ParagraphPdfDocumentReader are vulnerable to a denial of service when processing untrusted PDF input. The underlying text extraction logic reconstructs layout from a PDF's glyph positions and limits how much memory can be allocated for any single computed gap, but does not limit the cumulative allocation across an entire page. A specially crafted PDF can exploit this to force excessive memory allocation during processing, resulting in OutOfMemoryError. Depending on JVM configuration, this can cause request failures with degraded service under repeated exploitation, or…

Where mTLS client authentication is enforced, an accepted client certificate and its private key are also required. Successful exploitation bypasses Leader REST authentication and permits administrative API access.

items.title: CVE-2026-124559
items.summary: A flaw was found in QEMU's NBD server. A remote attacker can crash a multi-export NBD server process by exploiting stale metadata export state during an extended BLOCK_STATUS request, resulting in an assertion failure and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-135055
items.summary: A flaw was found in the GLib DMA-BUF path of WebKitGTK. The UIProcess trusted fds.size() as the DMA-BUF plane count when handling AcceleratedBackingStore::DidCreateDMABufBuffer and copied offsets and strides without verifying that those vectors had the same length. A compromised WebProcess can send mismatched vector lengths, causing an out-of-bounds read in the privileged UIProcess. This can disclose UIProcess memory and crash the UIProcess, and may be used as part of a Web Content sandbox-escape chain.

items.title: CVE-2026-126657
items.summary: A flaw was found in QEMU's NBD block driver. A malicious NBD server can send an incomplete structured read reply marked as done, causing QEMU to return uninitialized host heap memory to the guest VM, resulting in host memory disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-125683
items.summary: A flaw was found in QEMU's NBD server. A remote attacker can crash qemu-nbd, qemu-storage-daemon, or qemu-system by sending NBD_OPT_SET_META_CONTEXT or NBD_OPT_LIST_META_CONTEXT with a declared option length exceeding the actual payload, triggering an assertion failure and denial of service.

An application is affected if it passes untrusted input as an argument to a repository query method that declares a @Query with positional placeholders. In that case, a remote attacker can execute arbitrary code in the application, and repeated requests can exhaust memory throu…

items.title: CVE-2026-129830
items.summary: When the rsyslog's `imuxsock` is parsing the TAG field from a message with a accepted shorter timestamp, the cursor used to read the message fields and the remaining message length to be read are left in a inconsistent state in relation to the content in the raw message, leading the module to read one byte past the end of the buffer holding the message.

items.title: CVE-2026-134864
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that builds TRIANGLE_STRIP and TRIANGLE_FAN faces from unfilled faces. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file whose strip or fan primitives trigger out-of-bounds reads or null pointer dereferences, crashing the importing application.

items.title: CVE-2026-134730
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in xuxueli xxl-job 3.5.0/3.5.1-SNAPSHOT. The affected element is the function insert/update of the file admin/src/main/java/com/xxl/job/admin/business/controller/JobGroupController.java of the component Group Management. The manipulation of the argument addressList leads to cross-site request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-134802
items.summary: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade stricter ProxyAuth domain rules by sending percent-encoded path separators. Attackers can request paths with encoded slashes, backslashes, semicolons, or dot segments that match a broader rule, reaching restricted paths once the reverse proxy or backend decodes them.

items.title: CVE-2026-134788
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in warpdesign pcx-js up to 1.1.1. Affected is the function decode8bpp/decode4bpp of the file js/pcx.js of the component PCX Pixel Buffer Decoder. Performing a manipulation results in uncontrolled memory allocation. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-134868
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ColladaParser::ReadPrimitives that allows attackers to exhaust memory via non-numeric index values. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose index list contains a non-digit character, causing endless zero-index appends until the importing process crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-134867
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in FBXConverter::GetRotationKeyframeList that allows attackers to exhaust memory via unbounded rotation angle differences. Attackers can supply a crafted FBX file of about 111 KB whose keyframe interpolation loop never advances, consuming gigabytes of memory until the importing process is killed.

items.title: CVE-2026-134866
items.summary: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SkipLine that allows attackers to hang parsing by supplying files with '#' comment lines. Attackers can provide crafted OFF, LWS, or MD3 shader files so ReadFile never returns, consuming a CPU core and denying service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134865
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ColladaParser::CopyVertex that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying primitives lacking a VERTEX input. Attackers can provide a crafted Collada file whose SIZE_MAX per-vertex offset bypasses the release-removed ai_assert check, crashing the importing application.

items.title: CVE-2026-134863
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an invalid pointer dereference vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportEmbeddedTextures that derives the texture format hint without checking the strchr result. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with an embedded image mime type lacking a slash to crash the importing application.

items.title: CVE-2026-134862
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that uses NORMAL and TEXCOORD accessors without comparing their counts to the POSITION vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with shorter normal or texture coordinate arrays to trigger heap out-of-bounds reads and writes that crash the importing application.

items.title: CVE-2026-134861
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in glTFAsset.inl that allows attackers to corrupt memory via oversized glTF 1.0 accessor elements. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with VEC4 position or VEC3 index accessors to overflow heap or stack buffers during import, crashing applications.

items.title: CVE-2026-134860
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ReadFloat in ColladaLoader.cpp because accessor stride and offset bounds are checked only by ai_assert. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose animation accessor describes more values than its float_array holds to read past the array or dereference null, crashing the importing application.

items.title: CVE-2026-134859
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in PLYImporter::LoadFace and createFromeTriStrip that fails to validate face vertex indices against the vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted PLY file processed with normal generation but without aiProcess_ValidateDataStructure to crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory into generated normals.

items.title: CVE-2026-134840
items.summary: HumHub before 1.19.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController actionNewMemberSearch and actionAdminUserSearch, which skip the checkGroupAccess check. A manager of any single group can query admin-user-search and new-member-search with another group's id parameter to enumerate members, including administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-134839
items.summary: Linkwarden before 2.17.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the archive upload handler that allows collection members with only add permission to modify other users' links. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/v1/archives/ to replace another user's stored screenshot, PDF, readable, or HTML archive with attacker-supplied content.

items.title: CVE-2026-134782
items.summary: A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.6. This impacts the function Assimp::ColladaLoader::CreateMesh of the file code/AssetLib/Collada/ColladaLoader.cpp. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds read. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

items.title: CVE-2026-134837
items.summary: Frappe before 15.126.0 and 16.x before 16.55.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows Dashboard Manager users to pollute Object.prototype by storing __proto__ keys in Dashboard Chart custom_options. When any user, including administrators, views a dashboard rendering the chart, Object.assign merges attacker properties into Object.prototype, altering Frappe desk client behavior for that session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134836
items.summary: Dashy 4.0.0 before 4.9.12 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability in isLocalRequest that attaches user credentials to lookalike hosts due to prefix-only origin checks. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted ?config= link pointing to a lookalike host, capturing bearer tokens or HTTP auth headers to read configuration and stored API keys, or modify them when the victim is an admin.

items.title: CVE-2026-134834
items.summary: Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in Nextcloud.get_file that allows authenticated recipe editors to write and delete files by using unsanitized recipe names in temporary paths. Attackers can set a recipe name containing ../ segments via PATCH /api/recipe// and request /api/get_recipe_file// to overwrite and remove .pdf files outside the temporary directory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134832
items.summary: Vim 9.2.0405 before 9.2.1352 contains a security bypass vulnerability in expand_tag_fname() that allows attackers to evade 'tagsecure' URL checks by escaping URLs in tags file entries. Attackers can supply a crafted tags file in a cloned repository so that jumping to a tag makes netrw fetch an attacker-controlled URL leaking environment variable values.

items.title: CVE-2026-134828
items.summary: Penpot 2.18.0 before 2.19.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the sanitize-svg function that allows authenticated users to bypass filtering through unescaped re-serialization. Attackers with file edit permission can upload SVGs using entity-encoded or CDATA-wrapped markup or attribute quote breakouts to execute JavaScript in the Penpot origin when victims open them.

items.title: CVE-2026-134827
items.summary: Lightdash before 3.212.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability in getGitlabInstallationRepoReadAccess that sends the organization GitLab app token to unverified hosts. Project developers can set the dbt connection host_domain to an attacker-controlled server and capture the token when the AI agent reads the repository, gaining access to every reachable repository.

items.title: CVE-2026-134824
items.summary: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.98 contains a link following vulnerability that allows malicious repositories to read host files by setting --eventpath in an untrusted project .actrc to a symlink. Attackers can commit an event.json symlink pointing to files like ~/.ssh/id_rsa, which act copies into the job container as GITHUB_EVENT_PATH for workflow steps to exfiltrate.

items.title: CVE-2026-134823
items.summary: Kitty 0.43.0 before 0.51.0 contains a terminal escape sequence injection vulnerability that allows attackers to emit escape sequences by crafting malicious file or archive member names. When a victim highlights such an entry in the choose-files kitten preview panel, unsanitized names are written raw, enabling OSC 52 clipboard overwrites, OSC 8 links, window title changes, or screen spoofing.

items.title: CVE-2026-134819
items.summary: Delta Sharing reference server 1.4.0 before 1.5.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows share recipients to read unshared data via container-scoped Azure SAS tokens. Recipients with a valid bearer token can request credentials from the temporary-table-credentials endpoint to read every blob in the storage container, including unshared tables.

items.title: CVE-2026-134818
items.summary: oasdiff 1.24.0 before 1.34.1 fails to enforce --allow-external-refs=false when --open is used, because the recordingReader() capture reader in load/capture.go never applies the external-reference policy. Attackers supplying an untrusted OpenAPI spec can use external $ref values to read local files or trigger HTTP requests, with contents uploaded in the review bundle.

items.title: CVE-2026-134817
items.summary: mcp-server-kubernetes before 4.2.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows remote MCP clients to inject kubectl flags by supplying dash-prefixed values as positional operands in tools such as exec_in_pod, kubectl_patch, and kubectl_logs. Attackers connected over SSE or Streamable HTTP transport can supply values like --filename to make kubectl read files from the server host, bypassing file-read restrictions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134815
items.summary: simple-git before 4.1.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the allowUnsafePack guard by supplying the --exec option to non-push git operations. Attackers who influence arguments passed to listRemote() or raw() can inject --exec for ls-remote, archive, fetch-pack or send-pack to execute commands on the host.

items.title: CVE-2026-134814
items.summary: binary-parser before 2.3.1 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers controlling parser definitions to inject JavaScript through string-typed options passed unvalidated by Context.generateOption(). Attackers can supply crafted length, lengthInBytes, key, tag, offset, or namely() alias values to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the Node.js process when the parser is compiled.

items.title: CVE-2026-134812
items.summary: msgpackr before 2.1.4 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote attackers to cause denial of service by repeatedly re-decoding buffered incomplete values. Attackers can stream a large container of small elements in small chunks to UnpackrStream or decodeIter, triggering quadratic decoding cost that blocks the Node.js event loop.

items.title: CVE-2026-134811
items.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in Notifier#invite that allows authenticated users to inject HTML or markdown into invitation emails through unescaped profile names. Attackers can set profile first or last names containing raw HTML, links, or images so invitation emails sent from the pod render spoofed content in recipients' mail clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-134810
items.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a path traversal (zip slip) vulnerability in ImportService#unzip_photos_file that allows authenticated users to write files outside the extraction folder. Attackers can upload a crafted photos zip archive during account import with ../ entry names to create new files at arbitrary locations writable by the diaspora* process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134808
items.summary: Gogs before 0.14.4 on Windows contains a path equivalence vulnerability in isRepositoryGitPath that allows authenticated users with write access to bypass .git directory protection using NTFS aliases. Attackers can create, rename or upload files via aliases like git~1 or .git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION to overwrite .git/config or hooks and execute commands as the Gogs process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134806
items.summary: Opencast before 20.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in WorkspaceImpl.toWorkspaceFile that allows authenticated ingest users to write files outside the workspace root via unvalidated element paths. Attackers can submit media packages whose element URIs or identifiers contain ../ sequences, causing Workspace.get to create directories and write fetched content with Opencast process privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-134804
items.summary: Portainer 2.39.0 before 2.39.9, 2.40.0 before 2.45.4, and 3.0.0 before 3.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows Standard users to access other users' containers via the WebSocket attach and exec endpoints. Attackers with shared environment access can use leaked container or exec IDs to hijack sessions over /api/websocket/attach or /api/websocket/exec, gaining interactive root shells.

items.title: CVE-2026-134803
items.summary: DBHub before 1.7.0 contains a read-only mode bypass vulnerability that allows MCP clients restricted to readonly execute_sql to run write and DDL statements via backslash-escaped quotes. Attackers can hide stacked statements that clear transaction_read_only or COMMIT inside strings misparsed by scanSingleQuotedString, letting them modify or drop MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134801
items.summary: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an improper verification vulnerability that allows authenticated users to retain the emailVerified flag by changing their email address while EMAIL_VERIFICATION is disabled. Attackers with a previously verified account can set another person's address via the PATCH /email handler, receiving OIDC email_verified=true claims to impersonate that owner in relying applications.

items.title: CVE-2026-134800
items.summary: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to retain account access because the POST /reset_password/passkey/end handler never calls endUserSessions(). Attackers holding a stolen session cookie keep authenticated access to the victim's account even after the victim recovers it by registering a new passkey.

items.title: CVE-2026-134799
items.summary: ByteStash 1.5.0 before 1.6.1 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the /api/auth/oidc/callback handler because OIDC state is not bound to the initiating browser. Attackers can start an OIDC login with their own account and lure victims into opening the withheld callback URL, logging them into the attacker's account to read saved snippets.

items.title: CVE-2026-134798
items.summary: Donetick through 0.1.86 contains a blind server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows self-registered users to make the server send requests by setting unvalidated circle webhook or Discord notification URLs. Attackers can point these URLs at loopback or internal services, causing EventsProducer and the Discord notifier to POST partly attacker-influenced bodies to internal network hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-134797
items.summary: Donetick before 0.1.86 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to delete other users' files by storing a crafted image value via PUT /api/v1/users. Attackers can set their image to a traversal key and upload a new profile photo, causing storage.Delete to remove other users' attachments or photos under the storage root.

items.title: CVE-2026-134794
items.summary: HedgeDoc before 1.12.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in the POST /history/:noteId endpoint that allows authenticated users to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ as the noteId. Attackers can send a pinned value to /history/__proto__, which historyPost() in lib/history.js assigns onto the prototype, crashing the Node.js process and causing denial of service for all users.

items.title: CVE-2026-134793
items.summary: Electerm before 5.9.0 on Windows contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute PowerShell code via crafted file or folder names containing Unicode quote characters. Attackers can deliver names containing U+2019 through archives, WSL distributions, or SMB shares, which break out of getFolderSizeWin() and calcLocal() quoting when victims request folder sizes, executing code as the electerm user.

items.title: CVE-2026-134764
items.summary: Ground Station before 0.8.25 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrator operators to write files outside data/decoded via the post_process_pipeline value. Attackers can insert ../ sequences into a scheduled observation's IQ task configuration so SatDump creates directories, overwrites same-named files, and recursively deletes created trees on failure.

items.title: CVE-2026-134763
items.summary: FreeRDP before 3.33.1 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the WinPR wLinkedList collection because LinkedList_FreeNode() frees nodes without updating the cached list->current enumerator pointer. When calling code removes the node the enumerator references, LinkedList_Enumerator_MoveNext() or LinkedList_Enumerator_Current() reads freed heap memory, which can crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134761
items.summary: libical before 4.0.7 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in icalparser_clean() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying truncated iCalendar input. Attackers can provide an iCalendar file or stream missing a matching END line, causing the returned component to be freed twice and crashing applications.

items.title: CVE-2026-134732
items.summary: A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. This affects the function ASEImporter::InternReadFile of the file code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp of the component ASE File Importer. This manipulation causes out-of-bounds write. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 6.0.6 mitigates this issue. Patch name: 7ccc44a338dcdcc81023484388126ab1a8250e94. You should upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-134624 — N-able
items.summary: N-able — N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.title: CVE-2026-134829
items.summary: Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 contains a race condition in two-factor authentication attempt limiting that allows attackers holding a user's password to bypass lockout. Attackers can send many concurrent POST requests to /api/2fa/verify that pass checkRateLimit before recordFailedAttempt runs, brute-forcing TOTP or backup codes beyond the five-attempt limit.

items.title: CVE-2026-134765
items.summary: Kirby 5.0.0 before 5.6.4 contains a race condition in Kirby\Api\Upload::processChunk() that allows authenticated users with upload permission to bypass SVG sanitization. Attackers can race concurrent chunked uploads sharing a filename to swap a benign SVG with a script-bearing SVG, executing stored cross-site scripting in the site origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-134762
items.summary: ntop nDPI through 6.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and unsigned length underflow in ndpi_serializer_get_buffer() in src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c when stripping leading NUL and space bytes. Buffers holding only spaces or NULs, or a used length of 0 set through ndpi_serializer_set_buffer_len(), cause reads past the heap buffer or a wrapped 4294967295 length, crashing the embedding application.

items.title: CVE-2026-131786
items.summary: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in myCred myCred mycred allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects myCred: from n/a through 4.0.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-131750
items.summary: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Everest Forms Everest Forms everest-forms allows Path Traversal.This issue affects Everest Forms: from n/a through 3.6.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129024
items.summary: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Everest Forms Everest Forms everest-forms allows Path Traversal.This issue affects Everest Forms: from n/a through 3.6.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-132147
items.summary: An arbitrary file read vulnerability was discovered in debbugs, a bug tracking system based on the active Debian BTS. versions.cgi failed to correctly sanitize package name inputs in found and fixed query parameters. Crafted query parameters could cause version.cgi to output any lines of the target file which contained spaces.

items.title: CVE-2026-134757
items.summary: Anacrolix torrent before 1.63.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NewClient within tracker/http/client.go, which unconditionally sets InsecureSkipVerify to true for HTTPS trackers. Attackers able to intercept tracker traffic can impersonate trackers with any certificate, observe info_hash and peer_id values, and return forged peer lists.

items.title: CVE-2026-134624
items.summary: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.title: CVE-2026-131782
items.summary: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in mra13 / Team Tips and Tricks HQ Simple Shopping Cart wordpress-simple-paypal-shopping-cart allows Object Injection.This issue affects Simple Shopping Cart: from n/a through 5.3.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-131754
items.summary: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Pierre Lannoy APCu Manager apcu-manager allows Object Injection.This issue affects APCu Manager: from n/a through 4.6.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-129085
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Aguila Technologies WP Customer Area customer-area allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Customer Area: from n/a through 8.4.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-134758
items.summary: Wfuzz through 3.1.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows malicious target servers to inject script by returning crafted links written unescaped into HTML reports. When the links script and html printer are used, attacker-supplied href values close the unquoted anchor tag and execute JavaScript when the operator opens the report.

items.title: CVE-2026-134756
items.summary: Portainer Community Edition and Business Edition 2.39.0 before 2.45.1 contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability because user-supplied URLs are only syntax-checked by validate.IsURL without resolved address validation. Authenticated users can abuse Git cloning, Helm retrieval, registry ping, or the GitLab proxy to reach loopback, internal, and cloud metadata addresses, probing ports and reading responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-134755
items.summary: better-chatbot before 2.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that lets built-in tools run without user confirmation in Manual tool mode, because src/app/api/chat/route.ts keeps their execute handlers. Attackers can plant prompt-injected documents or web pages that make the HTTP request tool send conversation data to attacker-controlled URLs.

items.title: CVE-2026-134754
items.summary: anacrolix/torrent before 1.62.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in Decoder.readOneValue in bencode/decode.go that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying deeply nested bencode data. Attackers can deliver crafted .torrent files or magnet link metadata with millions of nested lists to cause a fatal stack overflow, or deeply nested v2 file trees to exhaust CPU.

items.title: CVE-2026-134749
items.summary: MemberPress Members before 3.3.1, with the Block Permissions add-on enabled, contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated Author-level users to crash pages by saving a non-string blockPermissionsMessage block attribute. Attackers can store a JSON array in the attribute so wpautop() in get_block_replacement_content() throws a PHP 8 TypeError, causing fatal errors on post, home, search, and REST pages for unauthorized viewers.

items.title: CVE-2026-131773
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Wetail AB WooCommerce Fortnox Integration woocommerce-fortnox-integration allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WooCommerce Fortnox Integration: from n/a through 4.8.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-131721
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WPMU DEV Forminator forminator allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Forminator: from n/a through 1.58.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-131701
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in JoomUnited WP Media folder wp-media-folder allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects WP Media folder: from n/a through 6.2.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-109889
items.summary: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Elementor Image Optimizer by Elementor image-optimization allows Path Traversal.This issue affects Image Optimizer by Elementor: from n/a through 1.7.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-131720
items.summary: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP BookIt bookit allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects BookIt: from n/a through 2.6.0.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-131707
items.summary: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Metagauss ProfileGrid profilegrid-user-profiles-groups-and-communities allows Object Injection.This issue affects ProfileGrid: from n/a through 6.0.0.6.

items.title: CVE-2026-131706
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Metagauss ProfileGrid profilegrid-user-profiles-groups-and-communities allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects ProfileGrid: from n/a through 6.0.0.6.

items.title: CVE-2026-131705
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Metagauss ProfileGrid profilegrid-user-profiles-groups-and-communities allows SQL Injection.This issue affects ProfileGrid: from n/a through 6.0.0.6.

items.title: CVE-2026-105394
items.summary: The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster WordPress plugin before 1.4.0.7 does not restrict which origins it reflects into its cross-origin resource sharing response headers and pairs the reflected origin with credentialed access, allowing a page on a related origin to read a logged-in user's authenticated content across origins.

items.title: CVE-2026-134616
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /deleteClient.php. Such manipulation of the argument client_id leads to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134572
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /deleteAgent.php. The manipulation of the argument agent_id leads to sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134667
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory via over-long object descriptor URL fragments. Attackers can craft an XMT scene file whose URL fragment overflows the fixed 5000-byte szURL buffer via sprintf, crashing MP4Box when a user loads it.

items.title: CVE-2026-134675
items.summary: Servas before 1.2.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify and delete other users' data by supplying target resource ids. Attackers can abuse TagController update and destroy, LinkController destroy, and GroupController destroy actions to rename or delete tags and delete links and groups.

items.title: CVE-2026-134659
items.summary: OpenAirInterface CN5G AMF before 2.2.2 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in amf_sbi::handle_itti_message() that leaves stale PDU session contexts when NRF lookup or SMF selection fails. Authenticated UEs can request PDU sessions while no SMF is selectable, causing deregistration to wait on SMF release timeouts and stall shared NAS processing for other UEs.

items.title: CVE-2026-134658
items.summary: free5GC SMF through 1.4.6 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in HandlePDUSessionSMContextCreate that leaves CHF charging sessions open when PCF session rule application fails. Attackers can repeatedly trigger failed PDU session establishments to accumulate orphaned charging sessions on the CHF and degrade its availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-134656
items.summary: OpenAirInterface CN5G SMF through 2.2.2 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in handle_pdu_session_release_sm_context_request() that fails to delete N7 SM policy associations at the PCF. Authenticated UEs can repeatedly establish and release PDU sessions through the AMF-initiated Release SM Context path to accumulate stale associations and exhaust PCF memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134655
items.summary: Open5GS AMF through 2.8.0 contains a missing resource release vulnerability that allows authenticated UEs to orphan SMF sessions by triggering Create SM Context response processing failures. Attackers can repeatedly release the RAN UE context while responses are pending, causing AMF_SESS_CLEAR() without Release SM Context requests and degrading SMF availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-134571
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file addPayment.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument client_id can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

items.title: CVE-2026-134570
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in itsourcecode Banking Management System 1.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file manage_user.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134569
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in itsourcecode Banking Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file /manage_request.php. Such manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134567
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in itsourcecode Document Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /showlist.php. The manipulation of the argument condition results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134566
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Document Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /edit.php. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134704
items.summary: OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-134703
items.summary: libexpat through 2.10.0 contains an improper Unicode handling vulnerability in DEFINE_UTF16_TO_UTF16 conversion functions in xmltok.c that can split valid surrogate pairs when output space is limited. In XML_UNICODE builds parsing non-native byte order UTF-16 input, attackers can supply crafted documents that deliver lone high surrogates to character data and default handlers.

items.title: CVE-2026-94259
items.summary: The SMS Alert WordPress plugin before 4.0.4 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, leading to SQL injection exploitable by administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-14233
items.summary: The LifterLMS WordPress plugin before 10.0.5 does not perform a capability or nonce check in one of its quiz-question query AJAX handlers, allowing any authenticated user with subscriber-level access to enumerate the titles of all published quiz questions, including those for courses they are not enrolled in.

items.title: CVE-2026-133362
items.summary: The ThinkRank SEO WordPress plugin before 2.21.4 does not ensure that the settings section a request acts on is the section it was authorized for, allowing users granted access to only one ThinkRank SEO WordPress plugin before 2.21.4 section by an administrator to read and update settings of other, more privileged sections, such as integration API keys and robots.txt content.

items.title: CVE-2026-107593
items.summary: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform a capability check on one of its AJAX actions and protects it only with a nonce that it outputs to every authenticated user on all admin pages, allowing any logged-in user, including Subscribers, to trigger a site-wide rewrite of stored book purchase links and change a related Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 option.

items.title: CVE-2026-107592
items.summary: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform any capability or nonce check in one of its AJAX actions, allowing any authenticated user with a minimal role such as Subscriber to change the publisher assigned to any book, including books created by other users, and to create new book records. The missing nonce check also makes the action exploitable via CSRF against any logged-in user.

items.title: CVE-2026-134702
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in curve2d_check_changes() that casts a Curve2D point field node to M_Coordinate2D without type checking. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BIFS scene placing another node type such as LinearGradient in that field, causing an invalid pointer read that crashes the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134701
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that leaves freed child node MFURL fields in the OD link list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with an extra top-level SceneReplace node, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

items.title: CVE-2026-134699
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M_FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build_text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134698
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in ctxload_process() in src/filters/load_bt_xmt.c that casts object descriptor update entries without checking the descriptor tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene placing a different descriptor type in a GF_ODUpdate command, causing gf_list_get() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134697
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() that allows attackers to crash the application via indexed field-replace commands lacking a payload. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose GF_SG_XREPLACE command on an MFNode field carries no value, causing a crash and denial of service when opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-134696
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del that allows attackers to free PROTOs still owned by another scene command via the GF_SG_PROTO_DELETE handler. Attackers can craft an XMT scene that declares a PROTO in one command and deletes it by ID in another, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory when opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-134695
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in avi_parse_input_file() in src/media_tools/avilib.c that increments track counters before checking AVI_MAX_TRACKS. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI file declaring a ninth audio stream, causing AVI_audio_format and AVI_close() to access track[8] and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134694
items.summary: Gammapy through 2.1 contains a code injection vulnerability in WcsGeom.from_header() that passes the WCSSHAPE FITS header card to eval(). Attackers can supply a crafted .fits file with a Python expression in WCSSHAPE, executing code as the user who loads it via Map.read().

items.title: CVE-2026-134693
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_create_node() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c when cloning PROTO instances. Attackers can craft an XMT scene declaring more PROTO interface fields than the cloned instance supplies, crashing MP4Box when a user opens the file.

items.title: CVE-2026-134692
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c resolves DEF names without verifying the node belongs to the current scene graph. Attackers can craft an XMT scene reusing a PROTO node across graphs, causing gf_node_unregister() to read freed memory during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134691
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf_event_target_get_node() because destroyed node event targets remain in media object lists. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nodes such as InputSensor to trigger freed memory reads during gf_scene_disconnect(), crashing the process or corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134690
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by supplying a crafted XMT scene. Attackers can modify InputSensor, Layout or EnvironmentTest nodes during parsing, triggering compositor handlers that read uninitialized private stacks and cause denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134689
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in JSScript_LoadVRML() in src/scenegraph/vrml_js.c that reads unchecked script_text pointers of Script node url entries. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene loading a Script node whose url entry lacks script text, crashing MP4Box and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134687
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c when handling MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with an MFNode field replace command lacking a node value to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134686
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c that misinterprets single node values as child lists for MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that causes an invalid node pointer to be dereferenced by gf_node_register(), crashing MP4Box for denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134685
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in load_xmt_done() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that reads freed nodes during XMT parser teardown. Attackers can craft an XMT scene with a scene replace command that destroys PROTO sub-graphs, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory when opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-134683
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_remove_od_links_recursive() in loader_xmt.c that lacks any depth limit when walking node children. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with deeply nested or cyclic node and SFCommandBuffer references to exhaust the stack and crash MP4Box on import.

items.title: CVE-2026-134682
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in scene graph teardown that allows attackers to trigger access to freed memory via crafted scene files. A node shared across multiple PROTO node_code lists is freed by gf_sg_reset(), and gf_sg_proto_del() then calls gf_node_unregister() on the dangling pointer, crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134681
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_instantiate() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that lacks cycle detection or depth limits. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose PROTO body instantiates itself directly or indirectly, exhausting the stack and crashing MP4Box when imported.

items.title: CVE-2026-134680
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in TraverseForm() in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c due to an off-by-one groupsIndex bounds check. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a Form node having constraints but an empty groupsIndex field to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134678
items.summary: Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the edit_post_post handler for POST /post/edit/:pid that skips ownership and status checks when a Private inn is submitted. Members of a Private inn can overwrite any post by sequential id, including moderator-locked posts, re-attributing it to themselves and destroying original content.

items.title: CVE-2026-134676
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf_odm_disconnect() in src/compositor/object_manager.c caused by a deferred scene_ns_remove_object task holding a raw object manager pointer. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose commands delete a Background2D node, freeing the object manager early to crash the process and corrupt heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134674
items.summary: Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the post_lock, post_hide, post_pin and comment_hide handlers that allows inn moderators to act on content from other inns. Attackers can supply their own inn id with a foreign post or comment id to lock or hide content instance-wide, or pin private posts to expose titles.

items.title: CVE-2026-134673
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to read freed heap memory via stale strstr() pointers. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose MFURL field contains an entry without a URL string, causing sprintf() to read freed memory and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134672
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_discard_subtree() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to exhaust the call stack. Attackers can persuade a user to process a crafted XMT file with deeply nested discarded SFNode and MFNode fields to crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134670
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that writes to freed heap memory when replacing single-node field commands. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file where a Conditional node owning the command is unregistered, corrupting heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134669
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() in src/utils/xml_parser.c that lets attackers read past the heap line buffer. Attackers can craft an XMT file whose ROUTE or command references a later-defined node, crashing MP4Box when a user imports it.

items.title: CVE-2026-134664
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_sensors.c that allows attackers to crash the process via uninitialized sensor nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that makes compositor_mpeg4_get_sensor_handler_ex() call hs->IsEnabled through a near-NULL pointer, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134661
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_odf_encode_ui_config() in src/odf/descriptors.c that allows attackers to crash the process. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file declaring an interaction stream without a UIConfig descriptor, causing a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134660
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that casts target nodes to GF_ParentNode without validation. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT-A file whose command targets a non-grouping node, causing gf_node_list_get_child() to perform an invalid memory read and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134657
items.summary: OpenAirInterface CN5G PCF through 2.2.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in pcf_smpc::delete_sm_policy_handler() that leaves stale UE IPv4, SUPI and DNN index entries after association deletion. Attackers can trigger repeated SM policy create and delete cycles over N7 via PDU session establishment and release to grow PCF memory without bound and break association lookups.

Patch name: e639d26e61b989b100f8b6f6bb78c0cecca79b99. You should upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-134553
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in wiroai Wiro-MCP up to 1.3.0. This affects the function upload_file of the file src/tools/upload-file.ts of the component File Upload. This manipulation of the argument url causes server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. Upgrading to version 1.3.1 is able to mitigate this issue. Patch name: ac61f79888fd36fae8e282995847e542c4ef1cbd. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

items.summary: A vulnerability was found in Xinchen Technology Huangjintong Second-level System Third-generation Management Terminal System up to 3.2. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /paraframework/storSelect.htm. The manipulation of the argument warehouseID results in sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in jprocms up to 1.7.7. Affected by this vulnerability is the function validateParam of the component Expression Language Handler. The manipulation leads to os command injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134541
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in Surya2Developer Online Shopping System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file product.php of the component GET Parameter Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument p results in sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-134540
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in ggml-org llama.cpp 0.7.0-dev. This affects the function common_sampler_init of the file common/sampling.cpp of the component llama-server. Such manipulation of the argument grammar_triggers[].type leads to improper input validation. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version b12405 mitigates this issue. The name of the patch is 9f26fe11c73c7e74a5e99e7f1b6370ad8e1cb22d. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

items.summary: A weakness has been identified in twogood unshield up to 1.6.2. Impacted is the function unshield_get_cab_descriptor of the file lib/libunshield.c of the component Cabinet Descriptor Parser. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds read. The attack requires local access. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Banking Management System 1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file manage_handover.php. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in liukuo362573 YiShaAdmin up to ba04d5072885447553e372bb87e372b55a90780c. Impacted is the function SqlServerPageSql/OraclePageSql/MySqlPageSql/ of the file YiSha.Data/YiSha.Data/Extension/DatabasePageExtension.cs of the component Pagination Sorting. The manipulation of the argument sort results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.
